items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: And they need a piano player. Now you're not doing no good here. She says, 'I just suggest that you go on down there and tell Eddie that I'm going down tomorrow, that you're ready to come.'

ctx.x: Yeah. Wait until she'd grow to sleep. So then, she told me, she says, 'Look, I'll tell you what. Mack, now, you have been raiding this ice box for the last two weeks. Now,' she says -- her son was playing with Eddie Hill's band in Shawnee, Oklahoma. She says, 'Now, why don't you just forget about this school.' And so I told her, 'Well, I'd like to stay here and finish up my exam, which would have been about another month or another four or five weeks, and she says,

"Well, I'll tell you what. I was just down there and saw my son," which was playing with this band." She says, "And they need a piano player. Now you're not doing no good here." She says, "I just suggest that you go on down there and tell Eddie that I'm going down tomorrow, that you're ready to come." I said, "Well, okay, just send me a ticket and $3."
